verdict.rationale: Secureframe has a dedicated ISO 27001 framework page claiming it helps customers achieve and maintain certification. Its supported frameworks include control mapping and automated control testing that collects evidence, so ISO 27001 is a supported framework, not just a mapping target. However, the pack never mentions the current (2022) Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability generation, or specific certification-audit artifacts. Missing for 10: evidence of the current Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability support, certification-audit artifacts or auditor workflow, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, ISO 27001 is a first-class framework — the current Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability, and certification-audit artifacts are supported, not just mapped

citations.quote: Achieve and maintain ISO 27001 certification so you can focus on growing your business globally.
Each supported framework includes control mapping to framework requirements, automated control testing that collects compliance evidence from integrated technologies
